title: A small change on a busy shift
visual_direction: Slow shoulder-height move along a quiet industrial aisle towards one blue pump skid. No sparks, emergency lights or people touching machinery.
screen_action: Add P-204 and the film title in the edit; hold the opening disclosure legibly for the full shot.
on_screen_copy: The next shift starts with the evidence | Hypothetical workflow · synthetic data
capture_acceptance: Generated geography matches H02 and H03; no baked-in lettering or fabricated product UI.
fallback: Use a licensed industrial still with a slow crop and the same disclosure.

title: The evidence is scattered
visual_direction: Four readable document cards on a neutral desk-like canvas. Bring the two revision cards into the same frame; keep their dates visible.
screen_action: Reveal OBS-204-01, WO-1187, MAN-P204-B and MAN-P204-C; add the illustrative trend as a small fifth card.
on_screen_copy: One asset. Several records. Two document revisions.
capture_acceptance: All titles, dates and IDs match scenario.json. Trend visibly says synthetic; no physical units or alarm threshold.
fallback: Use static cards with sequential highlights.

title: The technician reports an observation
visual_direction: Over-shoulder tablet framing, then a large transcript card. Avoid a recognisable commercial UI. Keep Maya away from moving equipment.
screen_action: Show the character line as a staged input. Highlight P-204 for confirmation, then the state Reported — cause unconfirmed.
on_screen_copy: Application concept · staged | Reported — cause unconfirmed
capture_acceptance: Voice-to-incident flow remains labelled staged until real input, transcript correction and stored-incident evidence exist.
fallback: Presenter reads the observation over the transcript card; no simulated recording waveform.

title: Give the records a common subject
visual_direction: Build a small left-to-right relationship view. Maximum seven visible nodes. Distinguish the pump, system and documents by shape as well as colour.
screen_action: Select P-204, then reveal its loop, line and attached records in that order.
capture_acceptance: Relationships come from the fixture, with no unsupported claim of automatic discovery or a live digital twin.

title: Make the source inspectable
visual_direction: Record a small demo Markdown note beside its source references, then an actual validation result. Crop to the content being discussed.
screen_action: Open NOTE-204 and show its asset identity. Run the supported validation command on a disposable, mapped demo corpus; preserve the real result.
on_screen_copy: Software capture · synthetic data — only after capture acceptance
capture_acceptance: Record exact command, build revision, mapped fixture and output. A passing result must not be renamed engineering approval.
fallback: Show the authored fixture note with Application concept · staged; omit terminal success graphics.

title: Find the current reference
visual_direction: Side-by-side B and C cards. Animate one supersedes arrow from C to B. Keep the earlier work record linked to B.
screen_action: Show 20 October on WO-1187 and 28 October on revision C. Do not alter the historical work record.
on_screen_copy: B: historical reference | C: current in this scenario
capture_acceptance: Supersession is a declared fixture relationship and application policy, not a claim of automatic industrial document control.

title: Explore the relationship, not a guess
visual_direction: Use VisionClaw’s real graph surface only after loading a verified demo mapping. Fixed camera; reveal one edge at a time.
screen_action: Select the asset and inspect its linked evidence. Keep labels readable; use the actual available controls.
on_screen_copy: Software capture · synthetic data — after verification | Relations, not a physical simulation
capture_acceptance: Selection, labels and evidence content must be visible in the actual frame. Record loader/mapping and build identity.
fallback: Use G03 with the Application concept · staged label; do not composite fake controls over a product screenshot.

title: From scattered papers to a shared view
visual_direction: Slow move from the same pump housing to a nearby meeting area. Match-cut the circular housing to the selected graph node in the edit.
screen_action: Add no holographic interface to the generated frame. The graph match-cut is an editorial device.
capture_acceptance: Same pump colour, aisle and lighting as H01. No suggestion that a generated scene measures machine state.
fallback: Use a second crop of the establishing still, then cut to the diagram.

title: Ask a bounded question
visual_direction: Start with the exact Q1 text, then show a real recorded retrieval response if available. Use an editorial annotation beside the response, never inside it.
screen_action: Open each cited source. Show the corpus identity in a small technical inset, not as a main user task.
on_screen_copy: What changed around P-204, and which records should we review?
capture_acceptance: A dedicated demo corpus is loaded; the request, response and visible references agree. Scripted answer cards remain staged.
fallback: Display the Q1 answer from the fixture as Application concept · staged; do not fabricate a service response.

title: Keep the unanswered question visible
visual_direction: One clear question and one short answer. Retain the two evidence references underneath; no confidence gauge.
screen_action: Show Q2 and its scripted answer. Keep Cause not established visible.
on_screen_copy: Cause not established by the available records
capture_acceptance: Treat the refusal wording as an application requirement until its real consumer policy and negative case are tested.
fallback: Presenter states the missing evidence over the source cards.

title: Review the exact knowledge change
visual_direction: Show the exact NOTE-204 before/after text as a readable diff. A real proposal surface may be used only when it displays the same scope and content.
screen_action: Highlight the revision correction first, then the explicit unresolved-cause sentence. Leave identity fields unchanged.
on_screen_copy: Review this note change | Cause remains unconfirmed
capture_acceptance: The displayed proposal identifies NOTE-204 and matches its fixture content. UI approval alone cannot certify application.
fallback: Use a labelled review-rehearsal diff; keep real product chrome out of the mock-up.

title: Separate a decision from its effects
visual_direction: Three large state cards with a separate receipt beneath each. Initially stop at reviewed; keep applied unfilled.
screen_action: Advance Proposed to Reviewed. Do not animate Applied until CAP05 supplies evidence, or label the whole sequence staged.
on_screen_copy: Proposed → Reviewed → Applied | Separate evidence for each step
capture_acceptance: Any connected success needs content/subject/digest agreement and actual output. Known audit gaps must not be concealed by animation.
fallback: Keep all three cards as an explanatory diagram with the staged label.

title: Hand a plan to the responsible person
visual_direction: Show PLAN-204 with owner, planner, current reference and open question. End on a clearly labelled manual handoff.
screen_action: Reveal owner Sam, planner Alex and the plan’s actual text. No work-order-created toast or machinery command.
on_screen_copy: Investigation plan | Manual handoff | Cause still open
capture_acceptance: The plan remains a proposal for authorised planning; no external system success or equipment action is implied.
fallback: Use a readable document page and presenter handoff.

title: Verify the supported change
visual_direction: Record a disposable single-note application and its output, then show the resulting diff. Include a short separate stale-context refusal take for production review.
screen_action: Use only a prepared demo repository and the supported writer command. Preserve the full receipt off-screen.
on_screen_copy: Applied note + actual receipt — only if verified
capture_acceptance: Inspect output bytes and subject/digest agreement. A direct CLI capture does not establish the full Agentbox-to-review-UI integration.
fallback: Show a staged before/after document with Manual rehearsal, not a fabricated application receipt.

title: Leave a useful handover
visual_direction: Full-screen HANDOVER-204 card with five short lines and source links. No completion checkmark on the incident.
screen_action: Read down observation, reference, reviewer, next owner and unresolved cause.
on_screen_copy: Open observation · Current reference · Reviewed change · Next owner · Open question
capture_acceptance: Every field matches the fixture. Any receipt link shown as clickable must resolve to actual captured evidence or remain visibly staged.
fallback: Use the handover text as a document slide.

title: The next shift can ask again
visual_direction: Ask Q3 in a fresh session. Show the actual answer and an opened updated note side by side.
screen_action: Record a fresh query after verified consumer refresh. Compare its served identity with the captured update.
capture_acceptance: Capture proves refreshed serving state and the same updated note. No reuse of the earlier Q1 recording as a new response.
fallback: Use the scripted Q3 card labelled Target behaviour · staged.

title: Reveal the small technical spine
visual_direction: Four labelled component cards around a central Evidence and decisions card. Add a separate dashed Application integration band.
screen_action: Reveal component jobs one at a time. Keep inspection, review and physical maintenance as separate concepts.
on_screen_copy: Authored knowledge · Grounding · Agent work · Graph and review
capture_acceptance: Diagram is labelled proposed composition. No arrow is presented as a currently tested complete industrial connection.
fallback: Use the same four cards without animation.

title: Invite a measurable pilot
visual_direction: Return to the same quiet aisle with a slight change of daylight. End on a clean title card over the frame.
screen_action: Do not show a repaired machine, a green production dashboard or an avoided-downtime number.
on_screen_copy: One asset. One question. A traceable handover.
capture_acceptance: Closing image suggests continuity, not an unmeasured repair or performance result.
fallback: Reuse a short approved H01 clip and a deterministic end card.
